steps.name: Home
steps.goal: If Your data and AI providers is visible, tap Agree and continue to enter the local demo. Otherwise only wait for the existing session list. Do not tap the composer.
steps.done: Home shows the api-gateway folder and the existing rate limiter session.
expect: Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window

steps.name: All artifacts
steps.goal: Open the side navigation using the computer button at the top left, then tap Artifacts.
steps.done: The all artifacts page includes output from two chats.

steps.name: Source chat
steps.goal: Tap the first Open chat button under Rate limit dashboard.
steps.done: The source chat opens with its artifact card.

steps.name: Open HTML
steps.goal: Tap the button labeled Open Rate limit dashboard near the top of the transcript. Do not tap Message or any composer control. If the keyboard is open, tap the artifact once to dismiss it and tap the artifact again to open it.

steps.name: Reload
steps.done: The freshly loaded dashboard counter is reset

steps.name: Artifact list
steps.goal: Go back to the transcript, open the session overflow menu, and select Artifacts
steps.done: The session artifact list is open

steps.name: Reopen
steps.done: The HTML artifact opens from the artifact list
